result.answer:
I couldn't summon the Concierge. A hook refused the spawn with "Not available in this session." So I worked as a child, read-only. Nothing in the house has been written.

**I haven't written a grant, because nothing in Kuramoto's rich face uses the camera.** The face has four interactive pieces: the two-phasor explorer (p5.js), the audio explorer (Tone.js), and the waveform-locking, ensemble and stubbornness pieces built on Web Audio. None of them asks for a camera in its code (`getUserMedia`, `createCapture`), and none says it needs one in its `piece:needs` tag.

A grant only works if the piece also says it needs the camera. The frame turns the camera on only when the piece asks for it and `_ops/rich-face/grants.json` has a line for it (`_ops/rich-face/contract.mjs:191-195`). A grant line for a Kuramoto piece would change nothing, except to widen what that piece is allowed to reach.

**The camera face that does exist is Language as a Tonal Medium.** It shows the five Semantic Webcam builds. Each one says it needs the camera in its manifest (`Language as a Tonal Medium/Language as a Tonal Medium — rich.json:40-42`, and the same for the other four). Each was granted today in `grants.json`, on your yes (commit `b2629ad2`). If that's the face you were looking at and it still can't reach the camera, a grant isn't what's missing; the fault is somewhere in how the face is served. The next step would be to run the piece checker in its browser mode (`node _ops/rich-face/conform.mjs "Language as a Tonal Medium"`). I tried a light version on Kuramoto and this session refused to run it, so I haven't verified anything past reading the files.

**Or you want Kuramoto to have a camera piece it doesn't have yet.** Fireflies that sync to your movement would fit the Cross-Domain Mirrors section. That starts as making: build the piece in the workshop with `camera` in its `piece:needs` tag. Then its line in `grants.json` goes in on your yes. On 2026-10-13 you turned down per-piece fixes for the camera and asked for the general solution. That solution is now built, so a grant line per piece is how it's meant to be used.

Which did you mean: the webcam face misbehaving, or a new camera piece for Kuramoto? Either way, the write to `grants.json` goes through the Concierge, which isn't available here. So I'd also need you to say "grow up" before I write it myself.
